## History

After his mother died when he was about twelve, Henry Warren was taken in by his aunt and uncle, who starved him and frequently whipped him in the garden behind their house to avoid being seen. He began having epileptic fits and grew up simple until he was about eighteen. Following his death, a story circulated that his ghost haunted the nearby [Bailey](../codex/places.md#bailey) garden.

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER XXIX. A WEIRD TALE P1](../source/v05-c29.md#nw-v05-c29-p0001), [v5 CHAPTER XXIX. A WEIRD TALE P9](../source/v05-c29.md#nw-v05-c29-p0009), [v5 CHAPTER XXIX. A WEIRD TALE P14](../source/v05-c29.md#nw-v05-c29-p0014)_
